title: latency-oscillation-detector-dashboard-streaming-vs-sync
creator: Ava Patel
description:
Goal: Build a diagnostic dashboard that detects and highlights latency oscillations (spikes, variance increases, and sustained percentile drift) broken down by model and route, with a clear split between streaming and non-streaming (sync) IO modes. The dashboard should surface p50/p95/p99 trends, short-term oscillation alerts (5/15/60m windows), and link to traces and logs for fast RCA.

Scope and acceptance criteria:
- Time-series panels for p50/p95/p99 per model x route with separate lines for streaming and sync. Defaults: 1h, 6h, 24h, 7d ranges.
- Oscillation detector: algorithmic signal that flags >30% increase in p95 over baseline OR increased p99 variance for 3 consecutive 5m buckets. Flag must attach to model+route+io_mode.
- Heatmap view: models on Y, routes on X, color by recent p95 delta vs baseline. Click-to-drill opens a focused timeseries + top traces.
- Trace hooks: add a moderate-sample (1%) high-latency trace sampling override for any flagged model+route so we capture traces during spikes. Implement sampling via existing trace-header config to avoid additional perf overhead.
- Metrics/data model: use existing telemetry buckets where possible. New derived metrics: latency.p50|p95|p99.{model}.{route}.{io_mode}, latency.p95_delta_{window}.{model}.{route}.{io_mode}. Ensure tags: model, route, io_mode (streaming|sync), region, customer_tier.
- Query cost: ensure pre-aggregated RB metrics for 5m windows for p95/p99 to avoid expensive real-time HdrHistogram scans.
- Dashboard links: direct links to Trace Explorer with pre-populated filters, Logs view filter, and relevant GitHub PR/Playbook.
- Alerts: initial alerting rule to notify SRE on high-severity oscillation with dedupe window 30m.

Implementation notes and trade-offs:
- Prefers pre-aggregated p95/p99 rollups to keep dashboard responsive at enterprise scale. Trade-off: slightly delayed detection for sub-minute spikes; acceptable for initial rollout.
- Oscillation algorithm tuned to reduce false positives from cold starts/rollouts by excluding windows where model rollout events exist (link rollout tags).
- Trace sampling override increases collected traces during incidents; cap at max 0.1% overall to control storage costs.

Tasks (engineering):
1) Instrument metrics: add io_mode tag to existing latency histograms and emit pre-aggregated p50/p95/p99 5m rollups. (ENG)
2) Implement oscillation detector microservice or streaming job that computes deltas and emits flags to metrics store. (ENG)
3) Dashboard panels: build timeseries, heatmap, and drill modal in Grafana/Console with trace & log deep-links. (ENG+Product)
4) Trace sampling hook: implement dynamic sampling override endpoint and integrate with tracer agent. (ENG)
5) Alerts & runbook: create Prometheus/Sentry style alerts and initial runbook for SRE/Oncall. (SRE)

Rollout plan:
- Week 1: Metrics tagging and rollups behind a feature flag; unit + integration tests.
- Week 2: Oscillation detector job and staging dashboard. Strong load testing for query costs.
- Week 3: Trace sampling hook + limited canary (internal customers only).
- Week 4: Feedback iteration, enable for 50% of orgs, create alerts and runbook.

Success metrics:
- Dashboard load latency < 2s for default 24h view for orgs with <100 routes.
- False positive rate for oscillation flags < 10% after tuning.
- Time to link to a trace from dashboard < 10s.

Open questions / Risks:
- Will pre-aggregated rollups be sufficient for p99 tail analysis for very large customers? (Possible follow-up: sampled real-time histograms.)
- How to represent multi-model pipelines where a single request touches multiple model routes? Proposed: primary route tagging and secondary route list in facet.
- Cost of trace capture during oscillations; need quota enforcement.

Related artifacts:
- Design sketch (Confluence): https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OBS/Latency+Oscillation+Detector+Design
- Initial proto dashboard (Grafana): https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/obs/latency-oscillation-proto
- Draft runbook: https://docs.redwood.ai/runbooks/latency-oscillation
- Example PR for metric tag change: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/7212
comments: 2026-03-10 - Ava Patel: Created ticket and added initial scope. Proposing pre-aggregated 5m rollups to avoid heavy queries for p99. Marking P1 due to recurring customer reports of unexplained latency spikes.

2026-03-11 - Marcus Lee: Ran quick ingest tests with synthetic traffic; confirmed adding io_mode tag increases cardinality but rollups keep query cost acceptable. Will prototype metric key format latency.p95.{model}.{route}.{io_mode}.
2026-03-12 - Sofia Guerrero (Design): Shared heatmap mock in Confluence. Suggested adding a compact sparkline per cell to show short-term trend—will add to acceptance criteria.

2026-03-13 - Marcus Lee: Implemented initial rollup emitter in staging (branch linked). Observed 8% CPU increase on router for 1% of traffic; need to optimize histogram serialization. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/telemetry/pull/198
